severity_levels.P1_CRITICAL: Data breach, unauthorized scoring, or cryptographic ledger tamper detection.
severity_levels.P2_HIGH: API rate-limit exhaust, unexpected drift alert, or auth token forgery attempt.
severity_levels.P3_MEDIUM: Degraded scoring response latency or MLflow logging failure.
severity_levels.P4_LOW: Non-critical metric reporting error or UI asset load failure.

kill_switch.fallback_response: 503 Service Unavailable - System in Emergency Manual Review Only Mode

quarantine.action: Revoke active OAuth tokens and isolate database payload keys.
